title: 第1章 身死第2章 落幕第3章 父母去世
content_zh:
第一卷 重生归来 第一章 身死
苏芮捂着嘴不敢置信的看着门内的两个人。那个男人她很熟悉，正式与她日夜相守的丈夫，那个对她百依百顺，温柔相待，说一辈子只爱她一个的丈夫。不！这不是真的，阿勇肯定有苦衷的。可是看这样的画面，这些解释又那么苍白无力。
正当她想要冲进去质问他时，那个女人余光瞄到敞开的门，眼神中满是轻蔑，讽刺的笑了笑说“勇哥，你什么时候跟那个臭女人离婚，娶人家进门啊~人家和你在一起这么多年一直有名无份的，你是不是真的爱上那个臭女人了”说着那个女人要哭出来似的。
“宝贝，我最爱的是谁你还不知道嘛，我已经设计让叶家与苏家倒台了，还剩下那几个也翻不起什么大风浪，过几天我就把她休了迎娶你过门。”说完男人更加卖力。
“不过真是要感谢她啊，若是没有她的帮助，我们吴家怎么能那么容易扳倒号称一流世家的叶家和苏家呢！嗯…”男人一阵抽搐。
吴勇休息片刻“那个女人的父母还真是大命不死，当初我爷爷设计他们遇到死亡，以为会斩断两家族的联姻，没想到他们还是在一起了，还有了孩子。哈哈。不过那也逃不出我们吴家的手掌心！”那个男人得意得意的说着，丝毫没有发现门外的苏芮。
门外的苏芮听到那个害她家破人亡的居然是她深爱的丈夫，而他父母的遇害也是那个对她和蔼可亲的吴勇的爷爷设计的。这让她如何的接受！而她的丈夫对她的温柔爱慕都是假的，难道她一直生活在谎言里么？！
苏芮很后悔！是她帮助仇人家族变得更强，是她偷听爷爷和外公谈话告诉吴勇。她都做了什么！想到这里，苏芮很想冲进去杀了那个贱男，为爷爷舅舅和哥哥报仇，可是理智阻止了她。她现在应该去告诉外公他们，不能再相信吴家，不能让外公他们在出事了。
想到爷爷去世时吴正道那个老匹夫惺惺作态的样子她气的要把银牙咬碎。转身跑出去的时候不小心碰到了茶几发出声音。
“谁”吴勇腾地一下坐起来。
遭了，被发现了。就在苏芮要藏起来时，吴勇已经围着浴巾走出卧室。
看见苏芮在客厅里，猫着腰准备出去的样子。脸上阴晴不定，冰冷的说到
“你都听到了。”是陈述句而不是问句。
事到如今苏芮也不能离开了。索性站直了身子。眼中充满复杂，徒自镇定的开口“刚刚你说的是真的么。苏家和叶家是你们吴家设计的，我父母出事故也是你爷爷设计的！难道就连接近我让我爱上你也是设计好的？！”
“当然是了，要不然你以为勇哥会多看你一眼吗！他爱的可是我，吴家正牌太太你也该让位了。”那个女人也从卧室出来轻蔑的说。
苏芮看向吴勇，当看到他眼中的默许和冷漠时，她终于忍不住。悲伤的要灭亡。
苏芮的脑子中放电影搬的闪现他们相遇的情景。
是啊，吴勇怎么会出现到那个小县城，又怎么会去那么脏乱差的大排档里吃东西还帮助她，这些疑点在认为吴勇爱她的时候被她认为是命中注定，现在看来这根本就是吴家设计好的，找到她然后帮助吴家图谋苏家和叶家！
怪她！误把奸人当良人！想通这些，她哈哈大笑，笑的有些癫狂。好似要毁天灭地。
吴勇有些吃惊的看着这个样子的苏芮，他从没见过这样的苏芮，有种另类的美，美得让他想要臣服！

他当然没见过这样的苏芮，试想一下14岁就失去父母一个人讨生活的孤儿怎么可能是柔弱的菟丝子，她只是在遇到吴勇之后以为将来会有王子保护她，所以才收起利爪，要知道军神苏家的子弟又怎么会成为娇弱的花朵。毕竟她流着战神的血脉！
那个女人发现吴勇看着苏芮愣住了，以为吴勇对苏芮还有私情，咬了咬牙想要叫醒他，就在这时，苏芮拿起茶几上的水果刀向吴勇冲过来，想要杀死吴勇为亲人报仇。
等吴勇反应过来时，他的手臂已经被划伤，可是毕竟他们有两个人，而苏芮只是一个人。推搡间苏芮把水果刀捅进那个女人的脸上，还没等她把水果刀拔出来在插一刀就被吴勇推倒，头撞上了茶几角。
“啊！勇哥！我好疼啊！勇哥救我！我的脸！”说着晕了过去。
吴勇赶快查看女人发现女人的脸上都是血，他马上找到电话打了120，然后去卫生间拿毛巾想要堵住女人脸上的血洞。等听到120的声音时，他才想起苏芮。
待他走到苏芮身边才发现苏芮的脑后都是血，而她已然没有了生息。
－－－－－－题外话－－－－－－

content_en:
Volume 1: Rebirth and Return Chapter 1: Death
Su Rui covered her mouth and looked at the two people inside the door in disbelief. She was very familiar with that man, the husband who stayed with her day and night, the husband who was obedient to her, treated each other tenderly, and said he would only love her for the rest of his life. No! This is not true, Ayong must have his own reasons. But looking at this picture, these explanations are so feeble.
Just when she was about to rush in and question him, the woman glanced at the open door from the corner of her eye. Her eyes were full of contempt. She smiled sarcastically and said, "Brother Yong, when will you divorce that stinky woman and marry someone else? She has been with you for so many years with no status and status. Have you really fallen in love with that stinky woman?" The woman said as if she was about to cry.
"Baby, you don't know who I love the most. I've already designed the fall of the Ye family and the Su family. The remaining few can't make any big trouble. I'll divorce her and marry you in a few days." After saying this, the man worked harder.
"But I really want to thank her. Without her help, how could our Wu family have so easily overthrown the Ye family and the Su family, which are known as first-class families! Well..." The man twitched.
Wu Yong took a moment to rest. "That woman's parents were really destined to die. My grandfather designed them to die, thinking that the marriage between the two families would be severed. Unexpectedly, they were still together and had a child. Haha. But that can't escape the grasp of our Wu family!" The man said proudly, not noticing Su Rui outside the door.
Su Rui outside the door heard that the person who destroyed her family was actually her beloved husband, and the murder of his parents was also designed by Wu Yong's grandfather, who was kind to her. How she accepted this! And her husband's tender love for her is all fake. Has she been living a lie? !
Su Rui regrets it! It was she who helped the enemy family become stronger, and it was she who eavesdropped on the conversation between her grandfather and grandpa and told Wu Yong. What has she done! Thinking of this, Su Rui wanted to rush in and kill the bitch to avenge her grandfather, uncle and brother, but her reason stopped her. She should go and tell her grandpa and the others now that they can no longer trust the Wu family, and they can't let grandpa and the others get into trouble.
Thinking of the coy old man Wu Zhengdao's behavior when her grandfather passed away, she was so angry that she wanted to bite her silver teeth into pieces. When he turned around and ran out, he accidentally touched the coffee table and made a sound.
"Who?" Wu Yong sat up suddenly.
Damn it, it was discovered. Just when Su Rui was about to hide, Wu Yong had already walked out of the bedroom wrapped in a bath towel.
I saw Su Rui in the living room, hunched over and ready to go out. His face was uncertain, and he said coldly
"You heard it all." It's a statement, not a question.
Su Rui can't leave now. He simply stood up straight. His eyes were full of complexity, and he spoke calmly, "Is what you just said true? The Su family and Ye family were designed by your Wu family, and my parents' accident was also designed by your grandfather! Could it be that even approaching me and making me fall in love with you was also designed?!"
"Of course, otherwise do you think Brother Yong will take another look at you! He loves me, and it's time for you, the real wife of the Wu family, to give up." The woman also came out of the bedroom and said contemptuously.
Su Rui looked at Wu Yong, and when she saw the acquiescence and indifference in his eyes, she finally couldn't help it. The sad ones will perish.
A movie played in Su Rui's mind, flashing back to the scene when they met.
Yes, how could Wu Yong appear in that small county town, and how could he go to such a dirty food stall to eat and help her? These doubts were considered by her as fate when she thought Wu Yong loved her. Now it seems that this was simply designed by the Wu family, to find her and help the Wu family plot against the Su family and the Ye family!
Blame her! Mistaking an evil person for a good person! After thinking about this, she laughed, a little crazy. It seems to destroy the world.
Wu Yong looked at this with some surprise.He had never seen Su Rui like this before. She had a different kind of beauty, so beautiful that he wanted to surrender!
Of course he had never seen Su Rui like this. Just imagine how an orphan who lost her parents at the age of 14 and had to live alone could be a weak dodder. She just thought that a prince would protect her in the future after meeting Wu Yong, so she put away her sharp claws. You have to know how the children of the military god Su family could become delicate flowers. After all, she has the blood of the God of War!
The woman noticed that Wu Yong was stunned when he looked at Su Rui, thinking that Wu Yong still had an affair with Su Rui, so she gritted her teeth and wanted to wake him up. At this moment, Su Rui picked up the fruit knife on the coffee table and rushed towards Wu Yong, wanting to kill Wu Yong to avenge his relatives.
When Wu Yong reacted, his arm had been scratched, but after all, there were two of them, and Su Rui was just one person. During the push, Su Rui stabbed the fruit knife into the woman's face. Before she could pull out the fruit knife and insert the knife, Wu Yong pushed her down and hit her head on the corner of the coffee table.
"Ah! Brother Yong! It hurts so much! Brother Yong, save me! My face!" He fainted.
Wu Yong quickly checked on the woman and found that her face was covered with blood. He immediately found the phone and called 120, and then went to the bathroom to get a towel to plug the bloody hole on the woman's face. Only when he heard the voice of 120 did he think of Su Rui.
When he walked to Su Rui, he found that the back of Su Rui's head was covered with blood and she was no longer alive.
